label: ENZYME Nomenclature Enrichment
description: For a pathway's reactions that carry an "Enzyme Nomenclature" (EC number) cross-reference, federates to UniProt's own SPARQL endpoint (sparql.uniprot.org) — which also serves the Expasy ENZYME database in RDF — to retrieve the enzyme's official name, synonyms and curator comments (catalytic notes, substrate range, species specificity).
